rules.restatement: When the same fiscal year appears in more than one 20-F, the later 20-F wins. Applied chain: segment revenue & operating income 2023-2025 from FY2025, 2022 from FY2024, 2021 from FY2023, 2020 from FY2022, 2019 from FY2021, 2018 from FY2020, 2017 from FY2019 (the only filing disclosing 2017 segments); business-line splits 2022-2024 from FY2024, 2021 from FY2023, 2020 from FY2022, 2019 from FY2021, 2018 from FY2020.
rules.missingData: Fields not disclosed for a year are omitted entirely. No zeros, no estimates, no interpolation.
rules.unitNormalization: Selected Financial Data tables through FY2016 are stated in RMB thousands and were divided by 1,000; FY2018 onward and all segment/disaggregation notes are already '(In millions)'. Units were confirmed from the surrounding table headers, not inferred from magnitude.

definitions.segments: Two reportable segments under ASC 280: Baidu Core (renamed 'Baidu General Business' from Q4 2025) and iQIYI, plus inter-segment eliminations and the consolidated column. Segment reporting starts with fiscal 2017 (iQIYI IPO March 2018).
definitions.nonOnlineMarketing: Consolidated level: the as-reported 'Others' revenue line (Baidu never uses the literal phrase 'non-online marketing').
definitions.coreNonOnlineMarketing: DERIVED, not as-reported: Baidu Core cloud services + others (+ the one-off 2018 'interest income earned from provision of financial services' of RMB1,724m).
definitions.aiCloudRevenue: The Baidu Core 'cloud services' line in the segment disaggregation of revenue note. Disclosed 2018-2024 only; FY2025 stopped disclosing the Core business-line split.
definitions.vatBreak: From January 1, 2018 (ASC 606) VAT is netted against revenues instead of sitting in cost of revenues, so 2005-2017 figures are gross of VAT and 2018+ are net. The FY2019 20-F restates 2017 ex-VAT: Core 63,903 (VAT 3,778) and iQIYI 16,396 (VAT 982); both are stored on year 2017 as coreRevenueExVat / iqiyiRevenueExVat.
definitions.operatingIncome: GAAP segment operating income (labelled 'Operating profit (loss)' in FY2022-FY2024), not non-GAAP. coreOpMargin = coreOpIncome / coreRevenue x 100, computed here.
definitions.employeesDrift: Wording drifts across filings: 'employees' through FY2018, 'full time employees' from FY2019, and 'approximately' rounding from FY2020 onward. 2017 and 2018 headcounts were restated downward in later filings.
definitions.epsBases: epsBasicPerShare / epsDilutedPerShare are per ordinary share; epsBasicPerAds / epsDilutedPerAds are per ADS. Dual-class (Class A/Class B) EPS with accretion of redeemable noncontrolling interests in the numerator.
definitions.adsRatioHistory: 1 ADS = 1 Class A ordinary share from the Aug 2005 IPO to May 11, 2010; 10 ADSs = 1 Class A ordinary share from May 12, 2010 (10-for-1 ADS split); 1-to-80 ordinary share subdivision on Mar 1, 2021 with a proportionate ratio change to 1 ADS = 8 Class A ordinary shares, applied retroactively. Consequence: per-ADS EPS is invariant across the 2021 subdivision (2019 per ADS 5.68/5.60 identical in the FY2019 and FY2021 filings) while per-share EPS is not; 2005-2007 per-ADS figures sit on the 1:1 basis and are roughly 10x the later ADS basis, flagged via epsPerAdsComparable=false.
definitions.epsPerShareToPerAdsFactor: Approximate multiplier linking that year's stored epsBasic/DilutedPerShare to the stored per-ADS value: 1.0 for 2005-2007 (1 ADS = 1 pre-subdivision share), 0.1 for 2008-2018 (10 ADSs = 1 pre-subdivision share), 8.0 for 2019-2025 (per-share figures are on the post-subdivision basis, 1 ADS = 8 shares). It differs from adsRatio, which records the ADS ratio wording in effect during that fiscal year. The factor is NOT exact: Baidu computes earnings per ADS on a separate Class A-only weighted-average ADS denominator, so e.g. FY2024 is reported as 8.31 per share and 66.40 per ADS (8.31 x 8 = 66.48). Always use the as-reported per-ADS fields rather than deriving them.

gaps.baiduAppMau: 2020-2025 only; gap 2005-2019 (FY2019 discloses Baidu App DAU 195m but no MAU; earlier filings only give mobile-search / Baidu Maps / smart mini program / iQIYI mobile MAUs)
gaps.apolloGoRides: 2022-2025 only; 2021 discloses cities (8) but no ride count; gap 2005-2021. 2024 and 2025 disclose only cumulative rides as of Jan 2025 / Feb 2026, with no annual figure.
